general.name: UniFi Endpoint - Version Behind Latest [Win]
general.description:
Alerts when UniFi Endpoint is older than Ubiquiti's latest release; stays quiet when unsure, alerts after staleDays blind.
Source: https://github.com/TechCollective/DattoRMM_Components/tree/main/Monitors/unifi-endpoint-version-behind-latest-win

variables.name: cacheHours
variables.description: 1-168. Hours a vendor lookup is reused before asking Ubiquiti again.

variables.name: graceDays
variables.description: 0-60. Days after a new release is first seen before alerting on it.

variables.name: staleDays
variables.description: 1-60. Days without a successful lookup before the monitor alerts about itself.

variables.name: alertIfMissing
variables.description: true = alert when UniFi Endpoint is not installed.
